title: @objectstack/mcp: export the app-docs answer rule and its served-check (packageDocAnswerRule, packageDocToolsServed) from the package barrel, so a host with its own initialize text can carry it
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ① a premise gap that a `repo:cloud` pin round measured (objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4907, pin `53c9575b7eb4`). It blocks objectstack-ai/cloud#4905, the cloud half of item 2 of the maintainer-directed p1 #35442 (「AI 的回答是真实的查了系统中的元数据和相关文档，还是编的」, 「都是 p1」). Reader: the `domain:server` lane (packages/mcp). Dedupe: `packageDocAnswerRule export`, `packageDocToolsServed barrel`: none.

Grade: p1 · Task · a blocker takes the top grade of what it blocks (cloud#4905 is p1).

## 维护者速读
- 要做的：把平台 MCP 里「先查应用手册、给出处」那段回答顺序，以及「两个手册工具是否都已提供」的判断，从包的入口导出。
- 为什么：云端的 MCP 入口自己写开场说明，要引用同一段文字，不能抄第二份。现在这两样都导不出来，云端没法引用。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Measured (objectstack `53c9575b7eb4`, from the cloud worktree)

- `packageDocAnswerRule` is module-local: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:1898`, with no `export`.
- `packageDocToolsServed` is exported from `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:3308`, but `src/index.ts` does not re-export it. The package's `exports` field has only `'.'`.
- A node import of `@objectstack/mcp` from cloud's `packages/objectos-runtime` resolves neither (both `false`).
- PR #35564 appends the rule only to the open server's default `initialize` text. A host that injects its own `instructions` / `dataOnlyInstructions` gets nothing appended, by design. The cloud build door is such a host.

## Done when

`@objectstack/mcp`'s barrel exports:
- `packageDocAnswerRule(definitionReader?)`, or the rule text plus a way to name the connection's definition reader;
- `packageDocToolsServed(...)`, with the reader-name list (or `definitionReaderServed`) the rule needs.

The open server keeps using the same export, so only one copy of the text exists. A test pins the barrel export.
